note: The second F281 batch: the eleven suspected stray covers (docs/research/2026-11-01-f281-triage.md section 8 item 1), each read on the replica before it was added, and the key-less Bills whose title is a file name (section 4.3). "id" is the full document id from the 2026-11-01 replica; prepare confirms it against NTER. strip_cover: cover_marker is the first characters of the bill's own text, occurring once; everything before it is removed. retitle: new title only (text, metadata and links unchanged, no key added; re-keying these is the Bills adapter's job, F275). new_title is the title printed in the opening of the document's own text, in the listing's case (checked by build: title_in_text); a heading OCR damaged is excluded, not repaired by hand.
